references.text: The Lord's blessing over the harvest and the storehouse, where God promises to command His blessing upon what they gather in.
An exhortation to bring tithes into the storehouse, with a promise that the Lord will open the windows of heaven and pour out blessings in abundance.
A blessing on the work of those who fear the Lord, with the promise that they shall enjoy the fruit of their labor.
A promise that the Lord your God will bless you in all you do and in everything you set your hand to.
The context for the blessings that follow obedience, including blessings in the city, in the field, and in all you undertake.
The Lord will open His rich storehouse, the heavens, to give rain to the land at the right time and bless all the work of your hands.
A promise of blessing over bread and water when the people of Israel serve the Lord their God.
